channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Eddie Jones vows Japan will ‘play the house down’ in matchup with England
item.description: Eddie Jones remains England's most successful coach in terms of winning percentage.

item.title: Japan considers setting five-year defense spending plan at ¥60 trillion
item.description: The Defense Ministry estimates that necessary defense expenditures for the five-year period will total ¥70 trillion to ¥80 trillion.

item.title: White House demanding Japan triple host-nation support for U.S. troops
item.description: The United States is demanding that Japan provide a total of ¥3 trillion over the five years starting in fiscal 2027 for U.S. forces stationed in the country under its Host Nation Support program, about three times the current five-year total of around ¥1 trillion, sources have said.

item.title: A beginner’s guide to camping in Japan
item.description: In a country with a convenience store on every corner and trains that are never late, camping is a wildly fun time.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
